name: Lidia von Erhart
original_name: リーティア・フォン・エアハルト
source:
Last main heroine. Lidia is cute. Like a little sister to [url=/c1039]Shiranui[/url] and [url=/c1040]Shizuku[/url], she can hold her own but chooses to rely on them. Her ability is the mech-inization of herself into a half jet unit and to summon a ninty-nine caliber pistol, coincidentally named Shiranui, which is the only thing that can penetrate a ‘factory’ wall. As such she is the military leader of Forsyse. 

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/07/09/a-tribute-to-evolution/]Warum's review[/url].]
